Seven questions, each answered with a page

An agent wrote each page with the explainer skill to answer the question in quotes. Every page is one HTML file that opens offline.

Install: npx skills add barisgit/explainer-skill

“Three quotes for a home battery: 5, 10 or 15 kWh. Which one?”

The first 5 kWh pays for itself in 10 years. The second would take 62.

    “Explain the change that ships ECharts compressed, so I can approve it.”

    Shipping ECharts compressed takes 513 KB off every chart page and costs 31 ms.

      “The sensor works at 100 kHz and drops bytes at 400 kHz. Why?”

      The 10 kΩ pull-ups take 847 ns to raise the line. At 400 kHz the bus allows 300.

        “Is wind and solar actually replacing coal?”

        Wind and solar added 669 TWh in 2024. Total generation added 1,265.

        “What did npm install actually put on my disk?”

        406 packages installed for 3 listed; 15 of them hold half the bytes.

        “Why does my square wave still ring after I add more terms?”

        Add a thousand sines and the corner still overshoots by 9%.

          “When does Dijkstra give the wrong answer?”

          One negative edge and Dijkstra answers 2 where the shortest path is 1.
